project.name: common-events
project.description:
Shared command/event contracts and topic names.
NOTE: sharing DTOs across microservices is a known coupling smell - a change here forces a rebuild of every service. It is a deliberate tradeoff for a 3-service solo project; the production evolution is a Schema Registry with Avro and per-service generated classes. See docs/adr/0003-shared-contracts.md.
